figure_contract.archetype: hero trajectory plus comparator small multiples and quantitative summary
figure_contract.core_claim: On the same fixed held-out layout and paired evaluation pool, the selected PCR episode completes all rows while each selected comparator terminates early.
figure_contract.results_question: Does PCR produce a complete traversal where alternative arbitration rules fail?
figure_contract.statistical_scope: Outcome-conditioned representative episodes only; formal aggregate rates belong in the evaluation table.

selection_rule.candidate_pool: seed-1, 64 environments, fixed layout and 0.60 m/s
selection_rule.distance_definition: mean absolute lateral-profile separation on the common forward grid plus 0.16 times terminal forward separation
selection_rule.diversity: PCR maximizes lateral range; two maximally separated Risk-only row-4 candidates preserve the prior greedy selection context; the displayed Risk-only member maximizes mean distance to the displayed non-Risk methods
selection_rule.outcomes: one successful PCR trajectory and failed baseline trajectories
selection_rule.row4_requirement: one failed Risk-only row-4 collision trajectory is shown

transformations: reused the exact deterministic representative-episode selection from the source plot
subtracted each environment world origin to recover layout-local coordinates
omitted the final post-reset sentinel row and marked the last pre-reset sample
rotated display axes so forward is horizontal and lateral is vertical
kept every trajectory and obstacle at physical 1:1 coordinate scale
placed each comparator in its own shared-scale panel instead of offsetting trajectories
summarized each representative endpoint on the same forward-position scale
no trajectory translation, stretching, smoothing, interpolation, resampling, or reselection
